name: Lunatone DALI-2 USB (LUBA)
description: DALI-2 bus master via a Lunatone DALI-2 USB interface (LUBA protocol): levels, status, settings read/write, D4i memory banks, addressing.
changelog:
## 0.3.1

- First version in the Muxit driver repo, with a `template.js` connector (`dali`) that the bundled "DALI status" dashboard and `dali-monitor` script bind to.
- The serial port is no longer opened with an empty line delimiter, and `release` leaves raw mode only after closing the port. Muxit's line splitter loops forever on an empty delimiter, so data arriving outside raw mode could hang the serial receive thread.
- When the interface does not answer the LUBA settings command at `open`, the port is closed again instead of staying open with `connected: true`.
